Nessus was able to obtain the following information about the host, by 
parsing the SMB2 Protocol's NTLM SSP message:

	Target Name: TADH
	NetBIOS Domain Name: TADH
	NetBIOS Computer Name: DC01-H
	DNS Domain Name: TADH.local
	DNS Computer Name: DC01-H.TADH.local
	DNS Tree Name: TADH.local
	Product Version: 10.0.17763
